context: A koban afternoon. Takeda is showing a new officer (placeholder: Ren, here as the trainee) how to handle a lost-item intake.
purpose: mentor + trainee — workplace patience, tiny instruction

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.style: Slides a form across the desk. Calm professional pacing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Mumbled focus. Pen already in hand.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 記入は三カ所だけ。本当に簡単。
lines.en: Only three fields to fill. Truly — simple.
lines.style: A small reassuring tone. Eye-contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.style: Half-laugh of nervous trainee. Doubting himself.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 本当に。最初は、誰でも緊張する。
lines.en: Truly. Everyone is nervous at first.
lines.style: A normalising kindness. Slow, even — with steady attentive presence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 時間、もう少しください、念のため。
lines.en: Just to be safe — a little more time, please.
lines.style: A small polite request. Voice careful.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 大丈夫。今日は、お客さん少ないから。
lines.style: A small reassurance with a small joke audible.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。
lines.style: A small bow inside the voice. Settles into the desk.
